record.question: Which country's topped in the Global Gender Gap Index 2017, published by the World Economic Forum on 2nd November 2017?
record.explanation: Answer B: Iceland. Iceland ranked first in the World Economic Forum Global Gender Gap Index 2017, ahead of Norway and Finland. The original report table gives rank 1 and score 0.878. Historical/source note: 2017 index edition; not an inference from the 2018 or current ranking. Full download timed out, but the original report’s indexed table and WEF’s 2017 announcement were consulted. Reference: https://www3.weforum.org/docs/WEF_GGGR_2017.pdf; https://www.weforum.org/media/ten-years-of-progress-on-global-gender-parity-stalls-in-2017. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
